design_direction.style: Social media native app with luminous violet, electric blue, and magenta highlights; strictly avoid boring job portal/admin table aesthetics.
design_direction.emotional_tone: Electric, premium, community-driven, fast, nocturnal-creator energy

visual_hierarchy: Nocturnal gradient backdrop with subtle noise grain and glowing radial purple aura
Dynamic creator story carousel with gradient active rings (#FF5FA2 -> #FFB86B -> #7C5CFF)
High-energy hook heading: 'Collab with Top Digital & IRL Creators'
Social-proof pill badge: '★ 1,200+ Verified Creator Deals Active'
Primary full-width CTA: 'Continue with Google / Apple' utilizing Clerk SSO
Secondary action: 'Explore Creator Directory as Guest' for zero-barrier preview
Footer legal & secure badge with 12px muted text

auth_callback_and_sign_in_return.flow_description: Native mobile sign-in returns via custom scheme redirect handled by Clerk and Capacitor App listener. On successful token exchange, immediately hydrate MeProvider and transition to target screen.

state_restoration.loading_view: Pulsing violet ring spinner with 'Synchronizing your creator pass...'
state_restoration.error_fallback: Glass card with 'Retry authentication' action and manual web fallback

discovery_feed.layout: Asymmetrical 2-column masonry or swipeable vertical reel cards with video/avatar badge overlays

elements: Creator full-bleed portrait with bottom gradient scrim (black/60 to transparent)
Verification checkmark & category tag (e.g. 'Virtual Influencer', 'TikTok AI', 'Fashion')
Engagement rate & starting offer badge ($250+ / collab)
Quick-action: Bookmark (Heart) and Quick Chat button

creator_business_profile.header: Full-bleed glowing banner with overlapping rounded avatar, gradient story border, stats ribbon (Followers, Completed Deals, Rating 4.9)
creator_business_profile.sticky_bottom_bar: Always visible glass CTA bar: 'Make an Offer' (brand gradient button) + 'Chat' icon button

chat_room.style: Fast messaging feed with custom bubble gradients (sent: brand-gradient violet/pink, received: glass-soft white/10)
chat_room.embedded_deal_card: Interactive mini-card inside chat showing Deal Status (Pitching -> In Escrow -> Completed) with instant 'Review Offer' action

deals_manager.style: Instagram/TikTok Shop styled deals kanban/list: segmented tabs ('Pending', 'In Progress', 'Delivered')

content_density_and_accessibility.spacing_scale: Strictly 8pt grid with mobile touch buffers (p-4 for screen container, gap-3 for cards, p-5 for modal drawers)
content_density_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA-compliant text contrast (all white text against minimum #2A1B7A or overlay scrim bg-black/60)
content_density_and_accessibility.no_transparent_surfaces: Dropdowns, bottom drawers, and sticky headers MUST use solid or saturated backdrop glass (bg-[#241464]/95 or higher) to avoid content bleed
content_density_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap framer-motion springs in prefers-reduced-motion checks; fallback to instant opacity transitions

instructions_to_main_agent: Never replace the nocturnal dark violet (#2A1B7A to #1F1150) gradient with sterile grey or white SaaS backgrounds.
Ensure all interactive components and action targets include the stipulated data-testid attributes.
Keep bottom navigation dock floating above the iOS home bar and Android system buttons with safe-area padding.
Support Clerk's native redirect scheme 'co.hireavatar.app://auth/callback' without blocking the user on blank screens.
Avoid flat job-board layouts; use social-media reels, cards, stories, and badges.
